# Forecast

#### Row {title="Skill"}

```{r}
#| title: "Better than the benchmark, by horizon"
if (has_live) {
  lt <- live_tab |> mutate(h = factor(as.character(h), rev(as.character(h))))
  plot_ly(lt, y = ~h, x = ~skill, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = ifelse(lt$skill > 0, "#15803d", "#b91c1c")),
          text = ~pct(skill, 1), textposition = "outside", cliponaxis = FALSE,
          customdata = ~format(quarters, big.mark = ","),
          hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{x:.1%} lower log loss, %{customdata} quarters<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(tickformat = ".0%", range = c(min(0, min(lt$skill)) - 0.01, max(lt$skill) * 1.3), zeroline = TRUE,
                        zerolinecolor = "#1c1917", gridcolor = "#f0ece8", title = ""),
           yaxis = list(title = ""), margin = list(l = 10, r = 20, t = 5, b = 25), bargap = 0.45,
           paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", font = list(color = "#78716c")) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
#| title: "When it says X%, how often it happens (next hour)"
if (!is.null(live_calib) && nrow(live_calib) > 0) {
  p <- plot_ly() |>
    add_lines(x = c(0, 1), y = c(0, 1), line = list(color = "#d6d3d1", dash = "dot"), name = "Perfect", hoverinfo = "skip")
  for (cl in c("down", "up")) {
    x <- filter(live_calib, class == cl)
    p <- p |> add_trace(data = x, x = ~forecast, y = ~observed, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
                        name = dir_labels[[cl]], line = list(color = dir_colors[[cl]], width = 2.5),
                        marker = list(color = dir_colors[[cl]], size = ~pmin(6 + sqrt(n) / 2, 22)),
                        text = ~format(n, big.mark = ","),
                        hovertemplate = "said %{x:.0%}, happened %{y:.0%} (%{text} quarters)<extra></extra>")
  }
  p |> chart_layout("Forecast probability", "How often it happened") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(tickformat = ".0%", range = c(0, 1)), yaxis = list(tickformat = ".0%", range = c(0, 1)),
           hovermode = "closest")
} else cat("Needs scored quarters.")
```

#### Column {title="Over time"}

```{r}
#| title: "Better than the benchmark, cumulative"
if (has_live) {
  cum <- live |>
    arrange(time) |>
    group_by(horizon) |>
    mutate(skill = 1 - cummean(ll_ens) / cummean(ll_clim), day = as_date(dk(time))) |>
    group_by(horizon, day) |>
    summarise(skill = last(skill), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(h = factor(horizon_labels[horizon], levels = horizon_labels))
  h_colors <- setNames(c("#1c7fb0", "#9a5b06", "#e7e5e4", "#e7e5e4", "#c0800c"), horizon_labels)
  plot_ly(cum, x = ~day, y = ~skill, color = ~h, colors = h_colors, type = "scatter",
          mode = "lines+markers", line = list(width = 2.5), marker = list(size = 7),
          hovertemplate = "%{y:.1%}") |>
    chart_layout() |>
    layout(yaxis = list(tickformat = ".0%", zeroline = TRUE),
           xaxis = list(type = "date", tickformat = "%d %b", dtick = 86400000))
} else {
  cat("No scored forecasts yet.")
}
```

```{r}
#| title: "Positions for the next day"
if (has_da_log) {
  pos_col <- c("-1" = "#c0800c", "0" = "#e7e5e4", "1" = "#15803d")
  pos_lab <- c("-1" = "Short", "0" = "None", "1" = "Long")

    if (nrow(x) > 0) p <- p |> add_bars(x = dk(x$time), y = x$expected, name = pos_lab[[k]], marker = list(color = pos_col[[k]]),
                                        hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>", pos_lab[[k]], "</extra>"))
  }
  p |> chart_layout() |> layout(barmode = "overlay", bargap = 0.15,
                                xaxis = list(type = "date", tickformat = "%H:%M", dtick = 2 * 3600 * 1000))
} else cat("No positions yet. They are made every morning between 10:30 and 11:55, before the noon auction.")
```

#### Column {title="Is it luck?"}

##### Row {height=42%}

```{r}
#| include: false
luck <- if (has_da_live && nrow(da_live) >= 10) {
  a <- nw_ci(da_live$ens); b <- nw_ci(da_live$ens - da_live$long)
  verdict <- \(r, what) if (r[["lo"]] > 0) paste(what, "is very unlikely to be luck.") else
    if (r[["hi"]] < 0) paste(what, "is very unlikely to be bad luck: it is really behind.") else
    paste(what, "could still be luck: the range includes 0.")
  list(a = a, b = b, n = nrow(da_live), va = verdict(a, "The profit"), vb = verdict(b, "The difference"))
}
```

::: {.card title="What this shows"}
A strategy can make money for a few weeks by chance. This checks whether the profit so far is more than that.

`r if (is.null(luck)) "It needs 10 traded days." else sprintf("**The strategy:** %s € a day on average over %d days. The true average is probably (95%%) between %s and %s € a day. %s", sprintf("%+.0f", luck$a[["m"]]), luck$n, sprintf("%+.0f", luck$a[["lo"]]), sprintf("%+.0f", luck$a[["hi"]]), luck$va)`

`r if (is.null(luck)) "" else sprintf("**Against always long** (never forecasting, just staying long): %s € a day, probably between %s and %s. %s", sprintf("%+.0f", luck$b[["m"]]), sprintf("%+.0f", luck$b[["lo"]]), sprintf("%+.0f", luck$b[["hi"]]), luck$vb)`

In the chart, the dot is the average and the grey bar the 95% range. A bar wholly right of the black zero line means real profit, one crossing it means not proven yet. The range is wide because the days vary a lot, and it narrows as days are added. Newey-West, so runs of good or bad days are allowed for.
:::

##### Row {height=58%}

```{r}
#| title: "€ a day, average and 95% range"
if (!is.null(luck)) ci_chart(da_live) else cat("Needs 10 traded days.")
```

## Row {height=87%}

```{r}
#| title: "Latest imbalance price, €/MWh. Red above the European middle, blue below, grey nothing recent"
m  <- eu_map |> filter(fresh)
gm <- eu_map |> filter(!fresh)
# one extreme area (poland at 1,100) would wash out the rest, so the colours stop at the 80th percentile distance from the middle
spread <- if (nrow(m)) max(quantile(abs(m$price - eu_mid), 0.8), 30) else 30
m <- m |> mutate(label = sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%s", area, formatC(round(price), big.mark = ",", format = "d")))
plot_ly() |>
  add_trace(type = "scattergeo", data = gm, lon = ~lon, lat = ~lat, text = ~area, hovertext = ~tip, hoverinfo = "text",
            mode = "markers+text", marker = list(size = 26, color = "#e7e5e4", line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 2)),
            textfont = list(color = "#a8a29e", size = 10), showlegend = FALSE) |>
  add_trace(type = "scattergeo", data = m, lon = ~lon, lat = ~lat, text = ~label, hovertext = ~tip, hoverinfo = "text",
            mode = "markers+text",
            marker = list(size = 38, color = ~pmin(pmax(price, eu_mid - spread), eu_mid + spread), cmin = eu_mid - spread, cmax = eu_mid + spread,
                          colorscale = list(c(0, "#1c7fb0"), c(0.5, "#ece8e3"), c(1, "#b32640")),
                          line = list(color = ifelse(m$area %in% c("DK1", "DK2"), "#1c1917", "#ffffff"), width = 2),
                          showscale = FALSE),
            textfont = list(color = "#1c1917", size = 9.5), showlegend = FALSE) |>
  layout(geo = list(scope = "europe", resolution = 50, projection = list(type = "mercator"),
                    lonaxis = list(range = c(-11, 33)), lataxis = list(range = c(36, 71)),
                    showland = TRUE, landcolor = "#f5f2ef", showcountries = TRUE, countrycolor = "#ffffff",
                    showocean = TRUE, oceancolor = "#ffffff", showlakes = FALSE, showframe = FALSE, coastlinecolor = "#d6d3d1",
                    bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"),
         margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 0, b = 0), paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
         hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "#ffffff", bordercolor = "#e7e5e4", font = list(color = "#1c1917"))) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```
